hooks.command: top=$(env -u GIT_DIR -u GIT_WORK_TREE -u GIT_COMMON_DIR -u GIT_INDEX_FILE git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$top" ] && [ -f "$top/.codex/hooks/bead-mirror-session.sh" ] && bash "$top/.codex/hooks/bead-mirror-session.sh"; exit 0

top=$(env -u GIT_DIR -u GIT_WORK_TREE -u GIT_COMMON_DIR -u GIT_INDEX_FILE git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$top" ] && [ -f "$top/.codex/hooks/block-generated-edits.py" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$top/.codex/hooks/block-generated-edits.py"

top=$(env -u GIT_DIR -u GIT_WORK_TREE -u GIT_COMMON_DIR -u GIT_INDEX_FILE git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$top" ] && [ -f "$top/.codex/hooks/autopilot-branch-guard.py" ] || exit 0; exec python3 "$top/.codex/hooks/autopilot-branch-guard.py"
